DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 74 s. 2022 AUG 05 2022 HON. EMILY Q. HYNSON Vice President Sangguniang Kabataan Pederasyon Iligan City emily.hynson2@gmail.com Dear SK Vice President Hynson: This pertains to your letter dated 15 June 2022 seeking legal advice relative •to the following. 1. Letter dated 6 June 2022 of Mr. Jaylord Dangan addressed to Hon. Nhicolle B. Capangpangan, Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) President of Iligan City, expressing Mr. Dangan's disfavor against the incumbent SK Pederasyon President to become the next President; 2. "Petition letter" dated 7 June 2022, signed by the twenty four (24) SK Pederasyon of Iligan City Officers, also addressed to SK Pederasyon President Capangpangan, wherein the signatories enumerated the alleged "unprofessional, unfair, and unlawful behavior" of the incumbent Vice President; 3. Notice to Explain and Notice of Hearing dated 9 June 2022, issued by SK Pederasyon President Capangpangan, asking you to attend the SK Pederasyon Regular Session/Meeting on IO June 2022 to explain and defend yourself as to why no "disciplinary action, including removal from position will be imposed upon you"; and 4. Declaration that the position of SK Pederasyon Vice President is vacant by virtue of a mere motion during the IO June 2022 Regular Session/Meeting This Department, together with the Commission on Elections (COMELEC), the National Youth Commission (NYC), issued Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-01 (JMC 2017-01), dated 23 June 2017. This JMC provides the guidelines on the conduct of SK Pederasyon Election, as well as rules governing terms of office, suspension and removal of all SK Pederasyon officers. Section 31(a) thereof states: "SECTION 31. GROUNDS FOR DISCIPLINARY ACTIONS (a) Any SK Pederasyon Officer may be disciplined, suspended, or removed from office, after due notice and hearing, on any of the following grounds: "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

I. 2. 3. 4. 5. Abuse of authority; Commission of any offense involving moral turpitude or an offense punishable by at least prision mayor (6 years and I day to 12 years) imprisonment; Failure to perform official duties and functions as Pederasyon Officer; Commission of any violations cited in the respective IRP of the concerned Pederasyon; and Such other grounds as may be provided under the Local Government Code of 1991, this JMC and all other applicable general and special laws. " Moreover, Section 32 of the same JMC provides for the rules on the form and filing of complaints, to wit: "SECTION 32. FORM AND FILING OF COMPLAINTS. - A verified complaint against any Pederasyon Officer shall be initiated only by any officer or member of the concerned Pederasyon and shall be filed before the •following: a. Office of the President, in the case of the Panlalawigan, PanlungsodÆayan Pederasyon Presidents who are ex-officio members of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, Panlunqsod (HUC, ICC or Component City), and the Pederasyon President of Pateros, NCR, respectively, or b. Sangguniang Panlalawigan. in the case of the Pambayang Pederasyon President who is an ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan (municipality), whose decision may be appealed to the Office of the President; or c. Sanggunian concerned, in the case of other officers of the concemedPederasyon, whose decision shall be final and executory Section 35 of the same JMC further provides that: "SECTION 35. SUSPENSION AND REMOVAL FROM OFFICE. - Any elected SK Pederasyon officer at all levels, after due process, may be suspended for not more than six (6) months, or removed from the office of the concerned Pederasyon, by a majority vote of all the members of the Sangguniang Panlungsod/Bayan or Panlalawigan concemed, or by the higher authorities, on grounds stated in Section 31(a)(b) of this JMC. In this case, and as emphasized in DILG Opinion No. 17, series of 2020, SK Pederasyon Vice President may be removed by a majority vote of all the mem>ers of the Sanggunian concerned. Since you are the incumbent Pederasyon Vice President of Iligan City, any officer of the SK Pederasyon who wishes to file a complaint against you based on the grounds provided in Section 31(a) of the JMC, must file the appropriate Verified Complaint Page 2 of 3

before the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Iligan, as specifically stated under Section 32(c) of the JMC. It is clear that it is the Sangguniang Panlungsod which has the sole authority to remove an SK Pederasyon Officer. Accordingly, a mere resolution from the concerned SK Pederasyon Officers% removing you from office, is not sufficient. This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion that will be rendered by more competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: INGAN Unders etary for Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLLs-LRALLD/rra0/clp copy furnish: DIR. ANEL M. AGABE Regional Director, DILG Region X KM3 Fr. W.F.
